As a candidate in the general election, I watched as our democracy came under assault, which I know sounds familiar today, by a president of the United States who was lawless and not committed to a free and fair election, and basically one of his lackeys, Lewis DeJoy, who's still today the postmaster general, the United States Postal Service, which sounds crazy to say, but it's true. And I also knew that everything was on the line. We couldn't endure another four years of the now disgraced defeated president of the United States, Donald Trump. And for that reason, I wanted to do something prior to even being elected to be helpful because, of course, what happened to the presidential level would also have ripple effects down at the congressional level as well. I mean, people were voting on the same ballot for various offices. So there was just a lot at stake, including majorities in the House of Representatives and in the Senate.
